title: Catch a falling friend
situation: Shim slips just ahead of her. Bola reacts a few frames late, steps in, and catches him under the arms from behind; his weight is then carried by her hands, which the balance check counts as support for him. The slip and his fall before the catch are declared. Both stabilise and he gets his feet back.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
